title: The crypt module was removed in Python 3.13
summary: Python 3.13 removed the crypt module (PEP 594), so importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError.
replacement: hashlib or a password-hashing library such as argon2-cffi

sources.title: PEP 594 — Removing dead batteries from the standard library

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the crypt import
steps.instructions: Replace each reported import of crypt with hashlib or a password-hashing library such as argon2-cffi.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings treated as errors when pytest is used.
